I came because I wanted to hear your story.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush: About Yaruru's father, I take it...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:E783}{n}Yes.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush: ...Very well. I will tell you.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush: My true name is Jackhound. Long ago I was a sacred beast who served the angels on earth.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush:{f7:E783}Even after the angels departed, I remained in Infos, and lived on earth for ages.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush:{f7:E783}I wished to live in peace among humans... but they would not accept me.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush:{f7:E783}My form made them fear me as a monster, and again and again I came to blows with them...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush:{f7:E783}So, little by little, I left the places where humans dwell, and came to live deep in the forest.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush: I gave up all dealings with foolish humankind...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush:{f7:E783}Then one day, a long time later, a fallen angel appeared before me.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush: He invited me to help him punish the foolish humans.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush:{f7:E783}Wishing to set humans right, I joined hands with the fallen angel. I attacked towns and burned villages...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}How could you...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush: Perhaps my one saving grace is that I never killed anyone with my own claws.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush: I had come to believe humans deserved to taste that much suffering...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:6580}{n}{e0:8D04}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush: It was then, here in the town of Alp, that I met a certain hero.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}That was Yaruru's father, wasn't it...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:7F04}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush:{f7:E783}He was a magnificent warrior. For three days we fought a battle so tense that the slightest lapse would have ended it.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:8004}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush:{f7:E783}...I wondered. What sort of man puts his life on the line to save the people of a town he does not even know?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:8104}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush:{f7:E783}If such men exist, I thought, perhaps humankind is not beyond saving after all...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:8204}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush: But the fallen angel did not think so...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}......{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:8304}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush: On the fourth day, I charged at him.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:8404}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush: An attack he could easily have dodged the day before.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:8504}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush: But... my horn ran deep through his belly.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:8604}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush:{f7:E783}I stared at him in shock. I never thought an attack like that would bring him down...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:8704}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush: And then I saw it: an arrow of light, lodged in his leg...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}An arrow of light...!!{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:8804}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush:{f7:E783}Yes. An arrow loosed by the fallen angel's monster. Because of it, he could not evade my attack.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:8904}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush: Shaking with rage, I called out the fallen angel and demanded to know why.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:8A04}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush: The fallen angel said he had helped me because I was struggling against a mere human.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:8B04}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush:{f7:E783}Hearing that, I flew at the fallen angel before I knew it... but he evaded me,{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:8C04}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush: and vanished, leaving these words: "A beast of the angels after all..."{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}......{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:6680}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush: I begged the hero's forgiveness...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush: The hero said, "It can't be helped." That this, too, was his fate as a hero...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush:{f7:E783}I asked him if he had any wish. I swore on my name as a sacred beast that I would surely keep that promise...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush:{f7:E783}He said there was little he wished for. Only...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush: that he worried for the wife and young son he had left at home.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush: That he wanted the two of them to live on safely... that was all.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush: And with those words, he breathed his last.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}I felt I had to protect his son, Yaruru Willing, and stay by his side until he became a strong hero like his father.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}I thought it was the least I could do to atone to him...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Then why... didn't you tell Yaruru...?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush: Before this journey began, I told Yaruru's mother everything.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush: She understood me...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush: Even Ludock's death, she said, was the end he would have chosen...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush: It seemed Yaruru's mother had long since made her peace with it.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush: But Yaruru is still young.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush: When we set out, I could not tell him everything.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush: Had I told it all too soon and he left me,{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush: I could no longer keep my promise to Ludock...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush: His mother hoped that on this journey Yaruru would come to know the world,{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush: and learn the truth with his own hands... That is what she said.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush: ...I have done all I can.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush: He has an angel like you at his side now, and he has grown into a fine hero...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush: He no longer needs me...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush: It is a pity that we must part this way, but...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}If...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}If that's what you think, then I'd like you to see Yaruru once more and talk with him properly.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}Yaruru has misunderstood you. If this goes on, he'll carry it with him for the rest of his life...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}To clear up that misunderstanding, won't you see Yaruru one more time...?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}{spk:E783}{n}{f7:0080}Rush: ...
